Alliance Consulting Services

The Haffty Consulting approach offers a singular and dedicated focus to MEDITECH customers. Our unique focus allows us to provide our clients with greater insights and understanding of MEDITECH’s capabilities and expertise to deliver better solutions and strategies. Haffty Consulting offers all levels of consulting support needed by new and existing MEDTECH EHR customers. We are a proud MEDITECH-certified consulting services Alliance Partner positioned to lead or support your Expanse project. In addition, we also specialize in providing project support and staff augmentation solutions. No matter the size or scope of a specific project, Haffty will customize a high quality, cost-effective solution that best fits each organization’s needs. Our mission is clear: accelerate the value of the EHR.

Consulting firm contact:
David LaFontaine, Partner, Sales and Client Partnerships
dlafontaine@hafftyconsulting.com
